HEADLINE. For each of seven potentials (Riesz r^-3; dipole d = 1/10, 1/2; dipole d/a = 0.06, 0.09, 0.1, 0.5) E(t) < E(0) for 0 < |t| <= 1e-5 along P_t L_rho, so the triangular lattice is NOT a local minimum of the model's harmonic zero-point energy over lattice shapes (harmonic approximation, 2D Bravais, one path, local window, model units). The sign is negative for all seven: the hoped-for first certified positive (local minimum) statement for an r^-3 potential did NOT happen. Filed C because it combines Tier A logic with Tier C-ball enclosures and Tier C-human glue. NOT claimed: real excitons, devices, melting, a structural transition, instability of the crystal, any global statement.
